The eight liturgical seasons of the SolSeed Movement, each with its own ritual used during the [[Weekly Service Calls]], represent a special kind of [[SolSeed Cosmic Calendar | Cosmic Calendar]]
* 1 - [[Genesis]] Winter Solstice to Mid Winter
* 2 - [[Conflatorium]] Mid Winter to Spring Equinox
* 3 - [[Viriditas de Terra]] Spring Equinox to Mid Spring
* 4 - [[Diversitas]] Mid Spring to Summer Solstice
* 5 - [[Sophos]] Summer Solstice to Mid Summer
* 6 - [[6th Season]] Mid Summer to Fall Equinox (draft)
* 7 - [[Viventibus Mundos]] Fall Equinox to Mid Fall
* 8 - [[Viventibus Galaxia]] Mid Fall to Winter Solstice
